# Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Business value

- What user or business problem does this solve?
- What outcome should improve?
- How will we know it worked?

## AI assistance used

- [ ] No AI assistance used
- [ ] AI assisted with exploration
- [ ] AI assisted with code changes
- [ ] AI assisted with tests
- [ ] AI assisted with documentation

If AI assistance was used, summarize what a human reviewed:


## Tests

- [ ] Automated tests added or updated
- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Not applicable

Commands or checks run:


## Risks

- What could break?
- Are there security, privacy, performance, migration, or adoption risks?
- Is any human approval required before release?

## Rollback plan

Describe how this change can be reverted, disabled, or mitigated if it causes problems.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots, recordings, logs, or before-and-after examples when relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to the stated problem.
- [ ] The implementation follows local patterns.
- [ ] Tests or manual checks are documented.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when needed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has human review.
- [ ] Product value is clear.
- [ ] Rollback or mitigation is understood.

## Suggested AI review prompts

- Use `.github/prompts/code-review-subagents.prompt.md` for multi-role pull request review.
- Use `.github/prompts/pr-product-review.prompt.md` for product and business value review.
